text_en: Oh... Would you look at that!
The board. There's no more assignments!
All the ones that came with a reward attached, indeed. My coffers are empty.
Who needs to keep their hair on now? Anyone would say you're having a harder time than he is.
Well, we're not talking about you, Makerel.
General Brigard said that he had a special prize for the person who could rid us of more monsters, and that's you!
No idea. Give him the good news and find out, you've earnt it.
